messages.author: 4e69b94a09c8cf3b
messages.subject: Re: "geom_boxplot" adds an non-existing point to the plot
parts:
This is the 'ol double plot problem. You are plotting a box plot and
a point plot (geom_jitter). The outlier point is plotted by
geom_boxplot and by geom_jitter. You can see this more clearly if you
set a color for geom_jitter().

Mark

messages.author: 1ce3d7d294da1b48
messages.subject: Re: "geom_boxplot" adds an non-existing point to the plot
parts:
To essentially get rid of the outlier being plotted by geom_boxplot you could add the outlier.color="transparent" option to geom_boxplot to get something like:

ggplot(df1,aes(factor(group),Age))+geom_boxplot(outlier.colour="transparent")+geom_jitter(position=position_jitter(width=0.1,height=0.05))

-Dason
